nodes.title: Era of One-Party Dominance: First three general elections, nature of Congress dominance at the
nodes.body: National level, uneven dominance at the state level, coalitional nature of Congress. Major opposition parties.

nodes.title: Nation - Building and Its Problems: Nehru’s approach to nation-building: Legacy of partition: challenge
nodes.body: of ‘refugee’ resettlement, the Kashmir problem. Organisation and reorgansation of states; Political conflicts over language.

nodes.title: Politics of Planned Development: Five year plans, expansion of state sector and the rise of new
India's External Relation: Nehru’s foreign policy. Sino-Indian war of 1962, Indo-Pak war of 1965
nodes.body: and 1971. India’s nuclear programme and shifting alliance in world politics.

nodes.title: Challenge to and Restoration of Congress System: Political succession after Nehru. NonCongressism
nodes.body: and electoral upset of 1967, Congress split and reconstitution, Congress’ victory in 1971 elections, politics of ‘garibi hatao’.

nodes.title: Crises of the Constitutional Order: Search for ‘committed’ bureaucracy and judiciary. Navnirman
nodes.body: movement in Gujarat and the Bihar movement. Emergency: context, constitutional and extra- constitutional dimensions, resistance to emergency. 1977 elections and the formation of Janata Party. Rise of civil liberties organisations.

nodes.title: Regional Aspiration and Conflicts: Rise of regional parties. Punjab crisis and the anti-Sikh riots of
nodes.body: 1984. The Kashmir situation. Challenges and responses in the North East.

nodes.title: Democratic Upsurge and Coalition Politics: Participatory upsurge in 1990s. Rise of the JD and the
nodes.body: BJP. Increasing role of regional parties and coalition politics. UF and NDA governments. Elections 2004-2019 and UPA government with addition of NDA government.

nodes.title: Recent Issues and Challenges: Challenge of and responses to globalization: new economic policy
nodes.body: and its opposition. Rise of OBCs in North Indian politics. Dalit politics in electoral and non-electoral arena. Challenge of communalism: Ayodhya issue. Contemporary World Politics.

nodes.title: Disintegration of the ‘Second World’ and the Collapse of Bipolarity: New entities in world politics:
nodes.body: Russia, Balkan states and, Central Asian states, Introduction of democratic politics and capitalism in post- communist regimes. India’s relations with Russia and other post-communist countries.

nodes.title: Alternative Centers of Economic and Political Power: Rise of China as an economic power in post-
nodes.body: Mao era, creation and expansion of European Union, ASEAN. India’s changing relations with China, Japan and South Korea.

nodes.title: South Asia in the Post Cold War Era: Democratisation and its reversals in Pakistan and Nepal.
nodes.body: Ethnic conflict in Sri Lanka. Impact of economic globalization on the region. Conflicts and efforts for peace in South Asia. India’s relation with its neighbours.

nodes.title: International Organisations in a Unipolar World: Restructuring and the future of the UN. India’s
nodes.body: position in the restructured UN. Rise of new international actors: new international economic organisations, NGOs. How democratic and accountable are the new institution of global governance?

nodes.title: Security in Contemporary World: Traditional concerns of security and politics of disarmament.
nodes.body: Non-traditional of human security: global poverty, health and education. Issues of human rights and migration.

nodes.title: Environment and Natural Resources in Global Politics: Environment movement and evolution of
nodes.body: global environmental norms. Conflicts over traditional and common property resources. Right of indigenous people. India’s stand in global environmental debates.

nodes.title: Globalisation and its critics: Economic, cultural and political manifestations. Debates on the nature
nodes.body: of consequences of globalization. Anti-globalisation movements. India as an arena of globalization and struggles against it.
